policy.TOKEN_VAZIO: unknown is preserved, never silently set to zero
policy.censorship: requires direct provenance of suppression/withholding; absence/access friction is insufficient
policy.negative_results: must be retained to reduce selection bias
policy.superseded_results: remain indexed but quarantined from active numerical use

entries.observation: Precision QCD-era H(T) requires temperature-dependent total g_rho(T) and g_s(T).
entries.risk: Constant Omega_r misses thermal thresholds/entropy redistribution.
entries.next_probe: Ingest Borsanyi full-SM supplementary g_rho/g_s table and hash it.

entries.observation: Extra-radiation constraints naturally map to omega_X=Omega_X h^2.
entries.risk: Direct Omega bounds inject unnecessary H0 degeneracy.
entries.next_probe: Keep primary receipts in omega h^2.

entries.observation: B/P are algebraic terms but canonical sign constraints are not implemented.
entries.risk: Signed cancellation can hide large individual terms.
entries.next_probe: Resolve sign/domain from authoritative model source.

entries.observation: a^-4 background does not specify free streaming, sound speed, viscosity or anisotropic stress.
entries.risk: Generic N_eff likelihood cannot be copied onto B/P.
entries.next_probe: Define perturbation equations before direct CMB likelihood.

entries.observation: Omega_B0 lacks B_lambda, spectrum, helicity and coherence mapping.
entries.risk: Cannot compare scalar Omega_B0 directly with PMF nG limits.
entries.next_probe: Canonicalize magnetic energy/spectrum/helicity/coherence conventions.

entries.observation: Omega_P0 lacks species, temperature, charge, coupling and EoS definition.
entries.risk: Plasma can interact with BBN/CMB matter rather than act as passive dark radiation.
entries.next_probe: Define microphysics or relabel as phenomenological radiation.

entries.observation: Physical-mass standard QCD at small chemical potential is a crossover.
entries.risk: Default bubble-GW parameters inject nonstandard physics.
entries.next_probe: Keep first-order GW branch conditional on explicit mechanism.

entries.observation: HotQCD fit gives a soft c_s^2 region around 145-150 MeV.
entries.risk: Ignoring it loses PBH/transfer sensitivity.
entries.next_probe: Propagate only into observables with explicit equations.

entries.observation: Charm becomes relevant toward/above roughly 300 MeV in cosmological EoS completion.
entries.risk: 2+1-flavor QCD is incomplete near upper range.
entries.next_probe: Use 2+1+1/full-SM completion.

entries.observation: Collider QGP and cosmic QCD differ in geometry, lifetime and baryochemical environment.
entries.risk: Uncontrolled transfer of transport/phase data creates false cosmological evidence.
entries.next_probe: Keep collider data QCD_CONTEXT until controlled mapping exists.

entries.observation: ALICE/CMS light-ion collectivity constrains QGP/nuclear geometry.
entries.risk: v2/v3 can be miscast as RLL evidence.
entries.next_probe: No likelihood edge without quantitative causal bridge.

entries.observation: Pre-2014 preliminary HISQ/tree EoS used incorrect fermion normalization and is superseded.
entries.risk: Old values contaminate ingestion without version state.
entries.next_probe: Quarantine as SUPERSEDED.

entries.observation: Access restriction, omission, supersession, correction, rejection and negative result are distinct from censorship.
entries.risk: Calling missing/paywalled material censorship fabricates causal intent.
entries.next_probe: Require actor, action, date, artifact, provenance and corroboration before documented withholding/censorship.

entries.observation: Some APS text is subscription-gated while accepted manuscripts/abstracts remain available.
entries.risk: Access friction can be mislabeled suppression.
entries.next_probe: Record alternate primary route and hash.

entries.observation: Magnetic/plasma sectors may alter reaction kinetics or entropy in addition to H.
entries.risk: Pure DeltaN_eff mapping may be incomplete.
entries.next_probe: Add reaction/entropy channels if B/P couples to SM.

entries.observation: Non-instantaneous neutrino decoupling gives standard effective N_eff about 3.044.
entries.risk: Using exactly 3 biases extra-radiation mapping.
entries.next_probe: Canonicalize N_eff_SM=3.044 with provenance.

entries.observation: Production/decay/thermalization between QCD, BBN and recombination changes T(a), eta and N_eff mapping.
entries.risk: a^-4 scaling alone does not establish shared entropy conservation.
entries.next_probe: Add Q_i source terms and entropy receipt.

entries.observation: Extra radiation changes pre-recombination H and therefore r_s/r_d and damping scales.
entries.risk: Late-time H0 alone misses CMB consequences.
entries.next_probe: Compute sound-horizon/damping response after perturbation contract.

entries.observation: Physical PMFs source anisotropic stress, vector/tensor modes, Faraday rotation and heating.
entries.risk: Homogeneous rho_B discards major signatures.
entries.next_probe: Add spectrum/helicity and transfer functions if Omega_B0 is PMF energy.

entries.observation: Energy injection/dissipation can produce CMB mu/y distortions.
entries.risk: FIRAS-style constraints may dominate for dissipative models.
entries.next_probe: Add distortion likelihood after dissipation history is defined.

entries.observation: Crossover EoS can alter transfer of a pre-existing stochastic GW background without bubble generation.
entries.risk: Source and transfer can be conflated.
entries.next_probe: Implement g_*(T) transfer response separately.

entries.observation: QCD softening changes collapse thresholds and PBH mass functions for a supplied primordial spectrum.
entries.risk: Abundance is exponentially assumption-sensitive.
entries.next_probe: Require P_zeta, non-Gaussianity and collapse prescription.

entries.observation: QCD topological susceptibility controls axion cosmology.
entries.risk: Unrelated axion freedom should not leak into RLL claims.
entries.next_probe: Keep orthogonal unless explicit RLL coupling/falsifier exists.

entries.observation: Model-preference promotion needs a post-RNG-fix converged reference MCMC receipt.
entries.risk: Historical posterior/Bayes numbers can bypass convergence governance.
entries.next_probe: Require Rhat/tau/ESS/seed/data hashes before promotion.

entries.observation: ACT DR6 null results on tested early-universe extensions are evidence and remain indexed.
entries.risk: Positive-only indexing causes selection bias.
entries.next_probe: Store null results with equal provenance.

entries.observation: RLL reduces to LCDM when all three RLL density extensions vanish.
entries.risk: A valid null limit is necessary but not evidence nonzero extensions are needed.
entries.next_probe: Compare nested null under identical likelihoods.
